firefox.notes: Firefox debs are available from the Mozilla PPA if you prefer apt over the default snap.

vlc.notes: VLC from apt integrates with classic desktop extensions out of the box.

gimp.notes: Install gimp from apt when you need plugin compatibility or scripts.

chromium.notes: Chromium is currently distributed as a snap on Ubuntu; the deb is only a stub.

multipass.notes: Multipass is officially distributed only as a snap by Canonical. Use `snap install multipass`.

libreoffice.notes: Use the apt meta-package for the classic LibreOffice desktop experience.
